senses.gloss: शामु-पाल (?) m. N. of a king, Buddh.
शामुल्य᳙ n. (perhaps connected with शमल) a woollen shirt, RV.
शामूल n. id., Kauś.; Lāṭy.
स॑-मूल mfn. having roots, overgrown, grassy, green, verdant, ŚBr.; Kauś.; R.
together with the root, root and branch, entire or entirely (also ibc. and अम् ind.), Br. &c. &c.
based upon, founded, Gobh., Sch.
सम्-उक्त mfn. spoken to, addressed, remonstrated or expostulated with, BhP.
सम्-उक्त See सं-√ वच्, p. 1114.
1. सम्-उदित mfn. (for 2. See under सम्-उद्-√ इ) spoken to or with, addressed, accosted, BhP.
agreed upon (see यथा-समुदितम्)
consented, settled, customary, Kathās.
2. सम्-उदित mfn. (for 1. See सं-√ वद्, p. 1114, col. 2) gone up, risen, elevated, lofty, R.; Kir.
collected, gathered together, united, assembled, R.; Daś.; Siddh.
possessed of, furnished with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; R.
furnished with everything, well supplied, wanting nothing, ib.
सम्-˚उद्य ind. having spoken together &c.
having concluded or agreed upon, BhP.
सम्-उद्य See सं-√ वद् and सम्-√ उद्, pp. 1114, 1166.
सम्-उद्-√ या P. -याति, to rise up against (acc.), assail, MBh.
सम्-उषित mfn. one who has passed or spent (time), BhP.
dwelled or lived together, stayed with, MW.
passed, spent (as time), ib.
सम्-उषित See सं-√ वस्, p. 1114, col. 3.
सम्-उह्य See under सम्- √ 1. ऊह्.
सम्-उह्य , सम्-ऊढ. See सम्- √ 1. ऊह्.
सम्-उह्य᳙ mfn. in comp. for सम्-ऊह्य.
1. सम्-ऊह्य᳙ mfn. to be swept together &c. (in Śulbas. = समुह्य᳙-पुरीष above), TS.; Kāṭh.
सम्-ऊह्य᳙ m. (scil. अग्नि) a kind of sacrificial fire (to be brought or carried by the priest), Pāṇ. iii, 1, 131
a place prepared for the reception of the sacrificial fire, W.
2. सम्-ऊह्य ind. having brought together.
सम्-ऊढ See under सम्- √ 1. ऊह्.
स॑म्-ऊढ mfn. (or -ऊळ्ह) swept or pressed together, brought together, collected, united, RV.; TS.
regularly arranged, restored to order (as opp. to व्य्-ऊढ, ‘disarranged’, ‘transposed’), Br.; ŚrS.
purified, L.
tamed, L.
सम्-मूढ mfn. completely stupefied, astounded, perplexed, bewildered, unconscious, senseless, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
foolish, ignorant, Yājñ.; Rājat.
heaped, accumulated (as clouds; accord. to others, ‘torn asunder’), Hariv.
produced rapidly, W.
broken, ib.
सम्-मूढा (आ), f. a kind of riddle or enigma, Cat.
सम्-उत See तर्द्म-स्˚.
समु a metre containing 76 syllables, Nidānas.
सम्-√ उक्ष् P. -उक्षति, to sprinkle well or thoroughly, besprinkle, pour over or out, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.
सम्-उक्षण n. the act of sprinkling or pouring over, shedding, effusion, Mālatīm.
स॑म्-उक्षित mfn. sprinkled, poured out, effused, RV.; AV.; MBh.
strengthened, increased, encouraged (cf. √ वक्ष्), RV.
स-मुख mfn. ‘mouthy’, talkative, loquacious, eloquent, L.
सम्-मुख॑ mf(ई rarely आ)n. facing, fronting, confronting, being face to face or in front of or opposite to (gen. or ifc. or ibc.), present, before the eyes, ŚBr. &c. &c.
being about to begin or at the beginning of (comp.), Hariv.
directed or turned towards, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
inclined or favourable to (gen. or comp.), propitious, Kāv.; Kathās.; Pañcat.
intent upon (loc. or comp.), Śatr.; Kathās.
adapted to circumstances, fit, suitable, Lalit.
with the mouth or face, ĀpŚr.
सम्-√ उच् P. -उच्यति (pf. -उवोच), to delight in, like to be together with (instr.), RV.

सम्-√ मुच् P. -मुञ्चति, to let loose together,
 pour out, discharge, shed (tears), MBh. :
Caus. -मोचयति See next.
सम्-उचित mfn. delighted in, liked, well suited, fit, right, proper, R.; Megh.; Inscr.
accustomed or used to (gen.), Megh.
सम्-उच्चित mfn. accumulated, collected together, regularly arranged, Kār. on Pāṇ. vii, 2, 10 (˚ती-कृत mfn. id., Naiṣ.)
सम्-उच्च mfn. lofty, high, KāśīKh.
सम्-उच्चर m. going or coming forth together, MW.
ascending, flying upwards, ib.
traversing, ib.
सम्-उच्चार m. utterance, pronunciation, KāśīKh.
सम्-˚उच्चारण n. (fr. Caus.) simultaneous utterance or pronunciation, Pāṇ. i, 3, 48.
सम्-उच्-√ चल् (-उद्-√ चल्) P. -चलति, to start or set out together, Daś.; Mālatīm.
सम्-उच्चय m. aggregation, accumulation, collection, assemblage, multitude, Kāv.
totality, aggregate, Kāv.; Suśr.; Kathās.
conjunction of words or sentences (as by the particle च, ‘and’), conjunctive sense (opp. to the disjunctive वा, ‘or’), Nir.; GṛS.; Suśr. &c.
(in rhet.) a figure of speech (the joining together of two or more independent things associated in idea with some common action), Sāh.; Kpr.
सम्-उच्च˚यालंकार m. the above rhetorical figure
सम्-उच्च˚योपमा f. a simile containing the above, Kāvyād. ii, 21.
सम्-˚उच्चयन n. collecting or heaping together, Pat.
सम्-उच्चिचीषा f. (fr. Desid.) the wish to accumulate or collect or combine or add together, VS., Sch.
सम्-उच्चिती-कृत mfn., id., Naiṣ.
सम्-उच्चेतव्य mfn. to be taken together or collectively (i.e. one equally with the other), Nyāyam.
सम्-˚उच्चेय mfn. id., ib., Sch.
सम्-उच्-√ छद् (-उद्- √ 1. छद्) P. -छादयति, to uncover, undress, MW.
सम्-उच्छन्न mfn. = सम्-उत्सन्न, uncovered, destroyed, annihilated, Prab. (v.l.)
सम्-उच्-छल् (-उद्-√ शल्) only in -उच्छलत् and -उच्छलित (mfn.) jerking or jerked up, Cat.
सम्-उच्-√ छिद् (-उद्-√ छिद्) P. Ā. -छिनत्ति, -छिन्त्ते, to cut up or off completely, tear up, uproot, exterminate, destroy utterly, MBh.; Pañcat.
सम्-उच्छित्ति f. cutting off completely, utter destruction, Divyāv.
सम्-उच्छिन्न mfn. torn up, uprooted, eradicated, utterly destroyed, lost, Sūryas.
सम्-उच्छिन्न—वासन mfn. one whose dress is torn off (or ‘one whose delusion is completely removed’), Prab.
सम्-उच्छेद m. utter destruction, extermination, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सम्-˚उच्छेदन n. id., Subh.
सम्-उच्-छुष् (-उद्-√ शुष्) P. -छुष्यति, to be or become completely dried up, Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-उच्-छ्रि (-उद्-√ श्रि) P. Ā. -छ्रयति, ˚ते (only 3. pl. pf. -उच्-छिश्रियुः), to raise well up, raise aloft, erect, elevate, Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-उच्छ्रय mfn. who or what rises or grows up (सर्वम् ˚रयम् = ‘all living beings’), R.
सम्-उच्छ्रय m. raising aloft, erection, elevation, MBh.; SaddhP.
height, length, Hariv.; Ragh.; VarBṛS.
an eminence, hill, mountain, MBh.
rising, rise, exaltation, high position, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
increase, growth, high degree, Hariv.; Suśr.
stimulation, Suśr.
accumulation, multitude, Kāraṇḍ.
(with, Buddh.) birth (according to others, ‘body’), Divyāv.
opposition, enmity, L.
सम्-˚उच्छ्राय m. rising, increase, growth, height, high degree, Suśr.; Dhātup.
सम्-उच्छ्रित mfn. well raised or elevated, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
surging, high, ib.
exalted, powerful, Suśr.
सम्-उच्छ्रित—ध्वज-वत् mfn. having flags hoisted (in it, said of a town), R.
सम्-उच्छ्रित—भुज mf(आ)n. having arms well raised, ib.
सम्-˚उच्छ्रिति f. augmentation, increase, growth, Suśr.
सम्-उच्छ्वसित mfn. breathed or sighed deeply (n. used impersonally), Amar.
सम्-उच्छ्वसित n. breathing, Kād.
a heavy or deep sigh, W.
सम्-˚उच्छ्वासित mfn. raised, elevated, swelled, Kum. iii, 38 (= वि-श्लेषित, Sch.)
सम्-˚उच्छ्वास m. heavy expiration, sighing, ib.
सम्-उज्-जिहीर्षु mfn. (fr. Desid. of 2. सम्-उद्-√ हृ) desirous of drawing up, Kir.
desirous of taking away or removing, BhP.

सम्-उज्-√ ज्वल् (-न्द्-√ ज्वल्) P. -ज्वलति, to blaze up with great intensity, shine very brightly, MBh. :
Caus. -ज्वलयते, to set on fire, kindle, GopBr.
सम्-उज्ज्वल mfn. shining, radiant, splendid in or with (comp.), Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
सम्-√ उज्झ् P. -उज्झति, to abandon, renounce, give up, Pañcat.
सम्-उज्झित mfn. abandoned, renounced, resigned, Prab.
(ifc.) free from, rid of ib.
सम्-उज्झित n. that which is left, a remnant, leavings (see भुक्त-स्˚).
स-मुञ्ज mfn. having Muñja grass, Gobh.
furnished with reeds, MānGṛ.
सम्-उत्क mfn. desirous of, longing for (comp.), Kathās.
सम्-उत्कच mfn. beginning to bloom, blooming, expanded, Pañcar.
सम्-उत्कट mfn. high, elevated, sublime, KāśīKh.
(ifc.) richly furnished with, Jātakam.
सम्-उत्कण्टकित mfn. having the hair (of the body) bristling or thrilled with joy or passion, Kād.
सम्-उत्कण्ठ Nom. Ā. -उत्कण्ठते, to think of regretfully, pine or long after, Sāh.
सम्-उत्कण्ठा f. wish or longing for (comp.), Vās.
सम्-उत्कम्पिन् mfn. trembling vehemently, Jātakam.
सम्-उत्-कीर्ण mfn. (√ कॄ) completely perforated or pierced, Ragh.
सम्-उत्-√ कृत् (only ind. -कृत्य), to cut off or out completely, MBh.

सम्-उत्-√ कृष् P. -कर्षति, to draw or raise well up, elevate, MBh.;
to draw tight (the bowstring), BhP.
सम्-उत्कर्ष m. self-elevation, setting one's self up (as belonging to a higher rank than one's own tribe), Mn. xi, 55
pre-eminence, excellence, MBh.; Bhar.
laying aside (a girdle), MBh.

सम्-उत्-√ क्रम् P. Ā. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, to go upwards, depart (from life), NādabUp.;
to overstep, transgress, violate, MBh.
सम्-उत्क्रम m. going upwards, rise, ascent, W.
transgressing proper bounds, MW.
सम्-उत्-क्रुष्ट mfn. (√ क्रुश्) cried out, called out, R.
सम्-उत्क्रोश m. crying out aloud, clamour, MW.
an osprey, L.
सम्-उत्-क्लिष्ट mfn. (√ क्लिश्) greatly distressed or disturbed, very uneasy or uncomfortable, Suśr.
सम्-उत्क्लेश m. great uneasiness or disturbance, Car.
सम्-उत्क्षेप m. throwing in (a word), allusion to (dat.), MBh. ii, 2513.
सम्-˚उत्क्षेपण n. the altitude above the horizon (opp. to नामन), Gol.
सम्-उत्तर n. = उत्तर, answer, reply, Sāh.
सम्-उत्तार m. passing over safely, deliverance from (comp.), Divyāv.
सम्-उत्तान mfn. = उत्तान, having the palms turned upwards (said of the hands), Cat.
सम्-उत्-√ तिज् Caus. -तिजयति, to excite, fire with enthusiasm, Divyāv.
सम्-उत्तेजक mfn. exciting, stimulating, SaddhP.
सम्-˚उत्तेजन n. the act of exciting or inflaming greatly, Mudr.
सम्-˚उत्तेजित mfn. (fr. Caus.) greatly excited or inflamed or irritated, W.
सम्-उत्तुङ्ग mfn. = उत्तुङ्ग, lofty, high, L.
सम्-उत्तीर्ण mfn. come forth from, escaped from, passed through, crossed, landed, Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
broken through, MBh. vii, 5219.
सम्-उत्-√ त्रस् Caus. -त्रासयति, to frighten thoroughly, terrify, Sāh.
सम्-उत्त्रस्त mfn. thoroughly frightened, greatly alarmed, ŚBr.
सम्-उत्थ mf(आ)n. rising up, risen, appearing, occurring in, occasioned by, sprung or produced or derived from (comp., rarely abl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सम्-उत्थान n. (ifc. f(आ). ) the act of rising up together, getting up, R.
hoisting (of a flag), Tithyād.
recovering from sickness or injury, MBh.
healing, cure, Mn.; Yājñ.
swelling (of the abdomen), R.
augmentation, increase, growth (of property), Yājñ.
rise, origin (ifc. = ‘rising or springing from’), Suśr.; Hariv.; Kāv.
performance of work, active operation, effort, industry (एकी-स्˚ or सम्भूय-स्˚ ‘common enterprise’, ‘co-operation’, ‘partnership’, Mn. viii, 4), Mn.; Kām.; MBh.; R.
indication or symptom of disease, L.
सम्-उत्थान—व्यय m. the expense of recovery or cure, Mn. viii, 287.
सम्-˚उत्थापक mfn. (fr. Caus.) rousing up, awakening, stirring, Buddh.
सम्-˚उत्थाप्य mfn. (fr. id.) to be raised or elevated, VarBṛS.

सम्-उत्थित mfn. risen up together, risen, raised (as dust), towering above (as a peak), surging (as waves), gathered (as clouds), MBh.; Kāv. &c. appeared, grown, sprung or obtained or derived from (abl. or comp.; धनं दण-समुत्थितम्, ‘money derived from fines’), ŚvetUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
ready, prepared for (loc.), MBh.; R.; BhP.
one who withstands all (opponents), R.
cured, healed, W.
swollen up, MW.
सम्-˚उत्थेय n. (impers.) it is to be risen (for action), MBh.

सम्-उत्-√ पट् P. -पाटयति, to tear completely out or up, uproot, detach, sever, MBh.; R.; Kathās.;
to expel, dethrone, Rājat.
सम्-उत्पाट m. tearing out or away, severing, detaching, W.
सम्-˚उत्पाटित mfn. torn completely out or away, uprooted, detached, ib.
सम्-उत्पतन n. the act of flying up together, rising, ascending, Pañcat.
making effort, energy, exertion, W.
सम्-उत्पतित mfn. flown up together, sprung up, risen, appeared, MBh.; Hariv.; BhP.
flown away, departed, gone, Pañcat.
exerted, vigorous, W.
सम्-˚उत्पतिष्णु mfn. desirous of standing or rising up, Harav.
सम्-उत्पात m. a portent (boding some calamity), MBh.; Ragh.
सम्-उत्पिपतिषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) about to start or spring up, Kir.

सम्-उत्-√ पद् Ā. -पद्यते (ep. also ˚ति), to spring up together, be brought forth or born of (loc.), arise, appear, occur, take place, happen, MBh.; Kāv. &c.:
Caus. -पादयति, to cause to arise, produce, effect, cause, MBh.; R.; Pur.
सम्-उत्पत्ति f. rising together, rise, birth, origin, Mn.; MBh. &c.
सम्-उत्पन्न mfn. sprung up together, arisen, produced, begotten by (abl.) or on (loc.), occurred, happened, taking place, Mn.; MBh. &c.
सम्-उत्पाद m. rise, origin, production, Sarvad.
सम्-˚उत्पादन n. (fr. Caus.) the act of bringing forth, producing, effecting, W.
सम्-˚उत्पाद्य mfn. to be produced or caused, Pañcat.
सम्-उत्पिञ्ज mfn. excessively confused or confounded, bewildered, disturbed, L.
सम्-उत्पिञ्ज m. complete confusion, MBh. vii, 8514.
सम्-उत्पिञ्जल (W.) and सम्-उत्पिञ्˚जलक (MBh.), m. id.
सम्-उत्पिञ्जल (W.) and सम्-उत्पिञ्˚जलक (MBh.), m. id.
सम्-उत्-पिष्ट mfn. (√ पिष्) crushed or squeezed together, greatly crushed, Suśr.
सम्-उत्-पीडन n. (√ पीड्) the act of pressing together, great pressure or distress, Dhūrtas.
सम्-उत्-पुंसन n. (see √ पुंस् and उत्पुंसय) wiping away, removing, destroying, Alaṃkārav.
सम्-उत्-√ पृ Caus. -पारयति, to spread out, stretch forth, MW.
सम्-उत्-√ प्लु Ā. -प्लवते, to jump or leap up together, move by jumps, Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-उत्फाल m. a jump, canter, gallop, L.
सम्-उत्फुल्ल mfn. (having the eyes) opened wide, Kād.
सम्-उत्-√ सद् Caus. -सादयति, to destroy utterly, overturn, overthrow, MBh.; R.
सम्-उत्सन्न mfn. utterly destroyed See समुच्छन्न.
सम्-उत्सव m. a great festival or festivity, R.

सम्-उत्-√ सह् Ā. -सहते (rarely P. ˚ति), to be able to or capable of, have energy to do anything (inf.), MBh.; R.; MārkP. :
Caus. -साहयति, to strengthen or encourage together, animate, incite, MBh.
सम्-उत्साह m. energy, force of will, MBh.; Suśr.
सम्-उत्साह—ता f. id. (with दाने, ‘alacrity in giving, great liberality’), Cāṇ.
सम्-उत्-सिक्त mfn. (√ sic) overflowing with, proud of (comp.), MBh.; R.
सम्-उत्सुक mf(आ)n. very uneasy or anxious, anxiously desirous, longing for (comp.), eager to (inf.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सम्-उत्सुक—ता f. desire, longing, Daś.
सम्-उत्सुक—त्व n. agitation, emotion, R.
= prec. Ṛtus.
सम्-उत्सुकय Nom. P. ˚यति, to cause to long for or yearn after, Kir.

सम्-उत्-√ सृ Caus. -सारयति, to send away, dismiss, MBh.;
to drive away, disperse, dispel, Kād.; Hcar.; Prab.
सम्-उत्सारक mfn. driving away, dispelling, Hcar.
सम्-˚उत्सारण n. the act of driving away &c., Kād.; Vās.
सम्-उत्सर्ग m. pouring out or shedding forth together (of urine), Mn. iv, 50
emission (of semen; ˚गं-√ कृ with loc., ‘to have sexual intercourse with’), Kull.
सम्-उत्सृष्ट mfn. altogether poured or shed forth, given away, wholly given up or abandoned, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

सम्-उत्-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to glide or soar upwards together, to rise up to (acc.), Ragh.;
to rise, set in, begin (as darkness), Amar. (v.l.)
सम्-उत्सर्पण n. getting along, proceeding, being accomplished, Inscr.
सम्-उत्सेध m. (ifc. f(आ). ) elevation, height, MBh.; R.
swelling up, intumescence, fatness, thickness, MW.
सम्-√ उद् (or उन्द्) P. -उनत्ति (ind.p. -उद्य, ‘having well moistened’), to moisten thoroughly, sprinkle all over, water, wet, PārGṛ.; Nir.
सम्-उ॑द् accord. to some = ‘conversation’, AV. viii, 1, 15.
स-मुद् mfn. joyful, glad, Śiś.
सम्-√ मुद् (only in pr. p. -मोदमान, q.v.)
सम्-मु॑द् f. joy, delight (cf. स्वादु-स्˚), AV.
सम्-√ उद् (or उन्द्) P. -उनत्ति (ind.p. -उद्य, ‘having well moistened’), to moisten thoroughly, sprinkle all over, water, wet, PārGṛ.; Nir.
सम्-√ उन्द् See सम्-√ उद्, p. 1166.

सम्-उद्र॑ m. (n. only, RV. vi, 72, 3; ifc. f(आ). cf. उद्र॑, अन्-उद्र॑; for स-मुद्र See p. 1168, col. 2) ‘gathering together of waters’, the sea, ocean (in Veda also ‘the aerial waters’, ‘atmospheric ocean or sky’ [cf. Naigh. i, 3]; in VP. ii, 4, seven circular concentric [elsewhere 3 or 4] oceans are named, viz. लवण, ‘salt-water’; इक्षु, ‘syrup’; सुरा, ‘wine’; घृत, ‘clarified butter’; दधि, ‘curds’; दुग्ध, ‘milk’; जल, ‘fresh water’; in later language the Ocean is often personified as king of the rivers), RV. &c. &c.
N. of the number, four (four principal oceans being reckoned by some, one for every quarter of the sky), Gaṇit.
a large Soma vessel, RV. vi, 69, 6; ix, 29, 3 &c.
N. of an immensely high number (1 with 14 cyphers), TS.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; MBh.
a partic. configuration of the stars and planets (when the 7 pl˚ are situated in the 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, 10th and 12th houses), VarBṛS.

सम्-उद्धूत (or समुद्धुत), mfn. shaken up, agitated, moved hither and thither, ib.;
 hurled or thrown near, MBh.

1. सम्-उद्-√ धृ (only in next).
सम्-उद्धरण n. the act of drawing well out or up, extricating, raising, lifting, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
taking off or away, removal, Cat.
eradication, extirpation, W.
taking out from (as a part or share), deduction, ib.
food thrown up (from the stomach), vomit, L.
सम्-˚उद्धर्तृ mfn. one who lifts up or raises or extricates from (abl.), MBh.; MārkP.
सम्-˚उद्धर्तृ m. an uptearer, extirpator, Ragh.
सम्-उद्धार m. drawing out, extraction from (abl.), MārkP.
extrication from any danger, rescue, delivery, Śatr.
removal, destruction, Kāv.
N. of a prince (for हरि-कृष्ण-स्˚), Kṣitīś.
सम्-उद्धृत mfn. well raised or drawn up or uplifted &c. &c.
taken out from (as a share), deducted (˚तोद्धारे, loc. ‘if a deduction be made’), Mn. ix, 116.

सम्-उद्धर्ष m. war, battle (perhaps w.r. for सम्-उद्घर्ष), MBh.
सम्-उद्-ध्वस्त mfn. (√ ध्वंस्) completely overspread, sprinkled or covered with (comp.), R.
सम्-उद्-√ बन्ध् (only ind.p. -बध्य), to bind up firmly, MBh.
सम्-उद्बन्धन n. hanging up (आत्मनः, ‘one's self’), Kād.
सम्-उद्-√ बुध् Caus. -बोधयति, to rouse up thoroughly, awaken, animate, Nīlak.
सम्-उद्बोध m. becoming consciousness, Sāh.
सम्-˚उद्बोधन n. (fr. Caus.) thorough rousing up, awakening (from a swoon), resuscitation, Prasannar.
सम्-उद्-√ बृह् P. -बृहति, to draw out together, pull out, MBh.
सम्-उद्भासन n. lighting up, illuminating, Kād.

सम्-उद्-√ भू P. -भवति, to spring up from, arise, be produced, exist, Kāv.;
to increase, augment, grow, Suśr.
सम्-उद्भव m. (ifc. f(आ). ) existence, production, origin (ifc. either ‘arisen or produced from’ or ‘being the source of’), Mn.; MBh. &c.
coming to life again, revival, MBh.
N. of Agni at the Vratādeśa, Gṛhyās.
सम्-उद्भूत mfn. sprung up, arisen, born, produced, derived, MBh.; R.; Pur.
existing, Pratāp.
v.l. or w.r. for सम्-उद्धूत or सम्-उद्धत, MBh.
सम्-˚उद्भूति f. arising, appearance, Sāh.
सम्-उद्भेद m. bursting forth, appearance, development, growth, Daśar.; Sāh.; iii, 8522.
सम्-उद्-भ्रान्त mfn. (√ भ्रम्) roused up, excited, bewildered, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

सम्-उद्-√ यम् P. -यच्छति, to raise up, lift up, MBh.; R. &c.;
to rein in, curb, restrain, drive (horses &c.), MBh.
सम्-उद्यत mfn. raised up, lifted up, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
offered, presented, R.; MārkP.
intended, prepared, begun, ib.
ready or eager for action, prepared to or about to (inf. or dat.), engaged in (loc.), R.; BhP.; Kathās.
ready to march against (प्रति), MBh. vi, 5166.
सम्-उद्यात mfn. risen up against (acc.)
सम्-उद्यम m. lifting up, MBh.
great effort or exertion, setting about, readiness to or for (loc. dat., or comp.), Kāv.; Kathās.
सम्-˚उद्यमिन् mfn. exerting one's self, strenuous, eager, zealous, Kām.
सम्-उद्-√ युज् Caus. -योजयति, to excite, animate, Mālav.; Prab.
सम्-उद्योग m. thorough preparation, making ready, setting about (acc. with Caus. of √ कृ and gen., ‘to undertake anything against’), MBh.; R. &c.
employment, use, MBh.
concurrence (of many causes), Pratāp.
स-मुद्र-लेखक mfn. marked with partic. inauspicious signs (perhaps w.r. for साम्˚), Buddh.
सम्-उद्-रिक्त mfn. (√ रिच्) abundantly furnished with (instr.), VP.
सम्-उद्-√ वस् Caus. -वासयति, to expel, remove, ŚBr.
सम्-उद्वह mfn. who or what lifts up, W.
moving up and down, ib.
सम्-˚उद्वाह m. bearing up, MW.
leading away, marriage, MBh.
सम्-उद्-√ विज् Ā. -विजते, to tremble greatly, shrink or start back together, MBh.
सम्-उद्विग्न mfn. greatly agitated or disturbed, terrified, anxious, R.; Pur.
सम्-˚उद्वेग m. great agitation or perturbation, terror, alarm, fear, MBh.
सम्-उद्-वीक्ष् (-वि-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. -वीक्षते, to look at together, look at, perceive, MBh.; Pañcat.
सम्-उद्-√ वृत् Caus. -वर्तयति, to cause to rise or swell, R.
सम्-उद्वृत्त mfn. risen up, swollen, MBh.
सम्-उद्-√ वृह् See सम्-उद्-√ बृह्.
सम्-उन्-√ नद् (-उद्-√ नद्) P. -नदति, to cry out together, shout out, roar out, MBh.; Hariv.
सम्-उन्नद m. N. of a Rākṣasa, R.
सम्-˚उन्नाद m. simultaneous roaring or shouting, MBh.

सम्-उन्-√ नम् (-उद्-√ नम्) P. -नमति, to rise up or ascend together, rise aloft, ascend, Bhaṭṭ. :
Caus. -नामयति or -नमयति, to raise well up, erect, lift completely up, elevate, MBh.; Śak.; Śuśr.
सम्-उन्नत mfn. risen up, lifted up, raised aloft, Kāv.
arched, vaulted, VarBṛS.; Rājat.
high, sublime, Kām.
proud, arrogant, W.
सम्-उन्नत—लाङ्गुल mfn. having the tail erect, Hit. (cf. सम्-उद्धत-ल्˚).
सम्-˚उन्नति f. rising, swelling, Subh.
exaltation, eminence, high position, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
elevation, increase, growth (with मनसः, ‘elevation of mind’; चित्तं समुन्नतिम् अश्नुते, ‘the spirit experiences elevation’), Kālid.; Pañcat.
सम्-उन्नमन n. raising, arching (as the brows), Sāh.
सम्-उन्नस mfn. having a prominent nose, Hariv.
सम्-उन्-√ नह् (-उद्-√ नह्) P. Ā. -नह्यति, ˚ते, to bind or tie up &c. (see next).
सम्-उन्नद्ध mfn. tied or bound up (= ऊर्ध्व-बद्ध), L.
swollen, pressed up or out, Suśr.
raised up, elevated, exalted, Kāv.; Pur.
full, excessive, BhP.
proud, arrogant, ib.
unfettered, loosened, ib.
produced, born, L.
सम्-उन्नाह m. pressing up or out, Suśr.
height, elevation, BhP.
सम्-उन्निद्र mfn. wide awake, opened wide (as eyes), Dharmaś.
सम्-उन्नय m. bringing out, inference, deduction, Cat.
occurrence, event, advent, Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-˚उन्नयन n. raising up, arching (as the brows), Daśar.
सम्-˚उन्नीत mfn. raised up, elevated, increased, MBh.
सम्-˚उन्नेय mfn. to be brought out or deduced, Sāh.
सम्-उन्-मज्ज् (-उद्-√ मज्ज् only ind.p. -मज्ज्य), to dive under, bathe, MBh.
सम्-उन्मिश्र mfn. mixed or mingled with, accompanied by (instr.), MBh.; Hariv.

सम्-उन्-√ मिष् (-उद्-√ मिष्) P. -मिषति, to rise up, spring up from (abl.), Rājat.;
to shine forth, shine bright, HYogay.
सम्-उन्मीलित mfn. opened, expanded, displayed, Prab.
सम्-उन्मुख mfn. ‘having the face erected’, upright, high (˚खी-√ कृ, ‘to lift up’), Naiṣ.
सम्-उन्-√ मूल् (उद्-√ मूल्) P. -मूलयति, to uproot or eradicate completely, exterminate or destroy utterly, Rājat.; Hit.
सम्-उन्मूलन n. the act of uprooting or eradicating completely, utter destruction, extermination, Uttarar.; Prab.

सम्-उन्-मृज् (-उद्-√ मृज्) to rub up, MaitrS.; MānŚr.;
to rub completely off or out, Kāṭh.
सम्-उप-√ कृष् P. -कर्षति, to draw towards at one time or together, draw near, R.

Caus. -कल्पयति, to make ready together, prepare, make ready, accomplish, MBh.

सम्-˚उपकॢप्त mfn. prepared or made ready together, ŚāṅkhŚr.

सम्-उप-√ क्रम् P. Ā. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, to go up to, approach, MW.;
to begin, commence to (inf.), MBh.; R.
सम्-उपक्रम m. commencement, L.
com˚ of medical treatment, Car.
सम्-˚उपक्रम्य mfn. to be treated medically, ib.
सम्-˚उपक्रान्त mfn. approached, MW.
one who has begun, R.
सम्-उपा-क्रान्त mfn. (√ क्रम्) one who has approached or attained to or arrived at (acc.), R.

to go to any state or condition, undergo, R.; Kathās.

to undergo, incur, get into any state or condition (acc.), R.
सम्-उपगत mfn. approached, W.
undergone, Śak.
सम्-उपागत mfn. gone near to, approached, met, come, arrived, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
one who has attained, R.
one who has incurred or undergone, ib.
सम्-उपगन्तव्य mfn. to be gone to &c.

सम्-उपगम m. going near, approach, contact, W.
सम्-उप-√ गुह् P. Ā. -गूहति, ˚ते, to embrace, surround, Caurap.
सम्-उप-√ घ्रा P. -जिघ्रति, to smell at, kiss, R.
सम्-उपा-√ घ्रा (only ind.p. -घ्राय), to smell at, kiss, MBh.; R.
सम्-उपचार m. attention, homage, Pañcar.

Pass. -चीयते, to grow up, increase, Suśr.
सम्-उपचित mfn. collected, heaped, W.
abundant, Ratnāv.
thick, Car.
सम्-उपचित—जल mfn. having accumulated waters (as the ocean), MW.
सम्-उप-च्छाद m. (√ 1. छद्), Pāṇ. vi, 4, 96, Sch.
सम्-उपजनित mfn. (fr. Caus.) generated, produced, caused, ib.
सम्-उपजात mfn. arisen, produced, Prab.
aroused, MW.
सम्-उपजात—कोप mfn. one whose anger is roused, provoked or moved to an˚, ib.
सम्-उपजा˚ताभिनिवेशम् ind. after having formed a determined resolution, Prab.
सम्-उपजोषम् ind. entirely according to wish or liking, quite contentedly (= उपज्˚, q.v.), L.

सम्-उप-√ ज्ञा P. Ā. -जानाति, -जानीते, to ascertain fully, find out, MBh.;
to perceive, learn, W.
सम्-उप-√ तप् Pass. -तप्यते, to feel pain, MBh.

सम्-उप-√ दिश् P. -दिशति, to point out or indicate fully, show, MBh.;
to assign (with acc. of person and of thing), R.
सम्-उप-√ दृश् Caus. -दर्शयति, to cause to see or be seen, show, exhibit, Kāraṇḍ.

सम्-उप-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति (ep. also Ā. ˚ते), to run together towards, rush upon (acc.), MBh.; R.;

सम्-उपद्रुत mfn. assailed, attacked, overrun, ib.
सम्-उप-√ धा P. Ā. -दधाति, -धत्ते, to put together, construct, create, produce, MW.
सम्-उप-√ धाव् P. -धावति, to run near or towards (acc.), MBh.
सम्-उपा-√ नी P. -नयति, to conduct or lead together towards, bring or gather together, assemble, R.
सम्-उपनयन n. the act of leading near to, Dharmaśarm.
सम्-उपानयन n. bringing near, procuring, MBh.
सम्-उपनीत mfn. brought or led to (acc.), R.
सम्-उपानीत mfn. brought together, gathered, assembled, MBh.
सम्-उप-न्य्-√ अस् P. -अस्यति, to lay down fully, state at full length, Hit.
सम्-उपन्यस्त mfn. fully stated, ib.
सम्-उपपादित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made ready, prepared, ib.
सम्-उप-प्लुत mfn. (√ प्लु) overwhelmed, assailed, distressed, R.
सम्-उप-√ बृह् Caus. -बृंहयति, to cause to increase, augment, strengthen, complete, MBh.; VāyuP.
सम्-उप-√ भुज् Ā. -भुङ्क्ते, to enjoy sexually, have sexual union with (acc.), MBh.; R.
सम्-उपभोग m. enjoying, eating, MBh.
cohabitation, sexual union, MW.
सम्-उपा-√ या P. -याति, to go up to together, go or resort to (acc.), approach, meet, MBh.; Kathās.
सम्-उपयात mfn. gone up to, approached (with acc.), ib.
सम्-उपायात mfn. come near, approached, arrived, Kāv.

सम्-उप-√ युज् P. -युनक्ति, to make complete use of, consume, MBh. :
Caus. -योजयति id., ib.
सम्-उपयुक्त mfn. completely used up or consumed, eaten, MW.
सम्-उपा-युक्त mfn. (√ युज्) furnished with, possessed of, surrounded by, full of (instr.), MBh.
सम्-˚उपयुक्त-वत् mfn. one who has consumed, MBh.
सम्-उपयोषम् ind. = समुपजोषम्, col. 1.

सम्-उप-√ रुज् P. -रुजति, to break or cut up, MW.;
to press hardly upon, Hariv.
सम्-उपा-√ रुज् = सम्-उप-√ रुज्

सम्-उप-√ रुध् P. -रुणद्धि, to hinder greatly, disturb, obstruct:

सम्-उप-√ लक्ष् P. Ā. -लक्षयति, ˚ते, to look at or observe attentively, Kām.;
to see, perceive, MBh.

to acquire by experience, learn, perceive, VarBṛS.

सम्-उप-√ वस् P. -वसति, to abide wholly in, engage in, devote one's self to (see below);
to abide in a state of abstinence, fast, Hcat.
सम्-उपोषक mfn. fasting, Kṛṣṇaj.
सम्-˚उपोषित mf(आ)n. engaged in, devoted to (acc.), MārkP.
one who has fasted, MBh.; VarBṛS.; BhP.

सम्-उप-√ वह् P. -वहति, to bear or carry along with, flow with, MBh. :
Pass. -उपोह्यते, to be borne near, approach, Hariv.
सम्-उपोढ See p. 1170, col. 2.
सम्-उपोढ mfn. (√ 1. ऊह्) brought near, presented, offered, Mn. vi, 41
commenced, begun (as a battle), R. (also -उपोळ्ह, ĀśvGṛ.)
risen (as the moon), Uttarar.

सम्-उपा-√ विश् P. -विशति, to enter upon together, undertake, begin, commence, R. :
Caus. -वेशयति, to conceal, hide, HPariś.
सम्-˚उपविष्ट mfn. seated, sat down, MBh.; Pañcat. &c.
सम्-उपवेश m. sitting down together, MW.
inviting any one to sit down or rest, entertaining, W.
a seat, Uttarar.
सम्-˚उपवेशन n. the act of causing to sit down, MW.
a habitation, building, ib.
a seat, Uttarar.
सम्-˚उपवेशित mfn. made to sit down, invited to rest, W.

सम्-उप-√ वृत् Ā. -वर्तते, to go together towards, proceed together, MW.;
to behave, R.
सम्-उप-√ शम् P. -साम्यति, to become quiet, cease, MBh.; Car.
सम्-उप-√ श्रु P. -सृणोति, to listen to anything (acc.), hear, hear or perceive any one (gen.), hear from or be told by any one (abl.), MBh.; R.; BhP.

सम्-उप-सं-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to restrain, stop (see next).
सम्-उपसंहृत mfn. restrained, stopped, Uttarar.

सम्-उप-√ सद् P. -सीदति to go to, approach (acc.), MBh.;
to get at, obtain (acc.), Śiś.
सम्-उप-√ सृ P. -सरति, to come near, approach, R.

सम्-उप-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to go to (acc.), approach, MBh.; R.; Bālar.;
to attack, MW.

सम्-उप-√ सेव् Ā. -सेवते, to make use of together, MW.;
to be addicted to, enjoy, R.
सम्-उपस्तम्भ m. propping, supporting, MBh.
a support, Car.
सम्-उपस्था f. standing near, approximation, proximity, W.
happening, befalling, ib.

to practise, observe, MBh.
सम्-˚उपस्थान n. approximation, approach, ib.
nearness, ib.
happening, occurring, ib.
सम्-उपस्थित mf(आ)n. approximated, approached, come to (तेषाम् अग्रतो नदी समुपस्थिता = ‘they came upon a river’), MBh.; Hariv.; R. &c.
sitting or lying on (loc.), R.
arisen, Hariv.
appeared, begun, imminent, MBh.; Hariv.; R. &c.
seasonable, opportune, MBh.
come upon, fallen to, fallen to one's share (with acc. or gen.), Kāv.; Bhag. &c.
ready for (dat. or loc.), MBh.; BhP.
undertaken, resolved, R.
attained, acquired, W.
सम्-उपास्थित mfn. come near, approached, MBh.; R.
सम्-˚उपस्थिति f. = ˚उपस्थान above, ib.
सम्-उप-हत mfn. (√ हन्) stricken, impaired (as reason), VarYogay.
सम्-उपहव See सम्-उप-√ ह्वे below.
सम्-उपहव॑ m. an invitation together with others, common invitation, Br.; Lāṭy.
सम्-उपह्वर m. a hidden place, hiding-place, MBh.

सम्-उप-√ ह्वे P. Ā. -ह्वयति, ˚ते (ind.p. -हूय, or -हावम्), to call together, invite, TS.; Br.; ŚrS.;
to challenge (to fight), MBh.; R.
सम्-उपा-√ कृ P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते, to satisfy, pay off, MBh.

सम्-उपा-√ चर् P. -चरति, to attend, wait on, treat (medically), Suśr.;
to practise, attend to, be intent upon (acc.), MBh.
सम्-उपात्त mfn. gained, acquired, taken, robbed, gathered, collected, MBh.; R. &c.
सम्-उपादाय ind. having gained &c. &c.
having used or employed (with acc. = ‘with the help of’, ‘by means of’), R.

सम्-उपा-रब्ध mfn. (√ रभ्) begun, commenced, undertaken, MBh.

सम्-उपारूढ mfn. mounted upon, ascended, R.

acquired, gained, ib.
stored up, ib.
